title: Betty Brussel broke three swimming world records before lunch

posts.facebook:
Betty Brussel didn't compete in swimming until she was 68. Thirty-one years later she set three world records in one day.

Betty Brussel began competitive swimming at 68 at the B.C. Seniors Games. On 20 January 2024, aged 99, she broke three world records in a single meet — and told the CBC the medals matter less than the company.

Starting at 68 still leaves room for three decades of improvement — and community is as much the point as the medals.
